kind: code hygiene; no experiment, model, peer job or simulation

live_read_only_check.note: host-dependent snapshot from read-only ps at recorded_utc; not an acceptance fixture

limits: not seen by a command-line scan (needs an ownership lease): a module name built at run time; a copied or symlinked script under another name; indirect imports (for example a test run); code typed into an interactive shell or REPL whose command lines never name the module; a heredoc launched by zsh -c/-lc (zsh 5.9 execs its last command, so the heredoc text is in no process arguments); a renamed argv[0] (exec -a, setproctitle)

conservative false positives (the gate blocks; inspect and retry): a concurrent read-only process_gate check; pgrep/tail monitors naming a model server; foreign processes whose arguments name a model server; editors, tail or test runs whose arguments contain dev_batch or coverage_batch; an unrelated stdin python under a wrapper whose text names the module

review.round1: blocker: unknown-identity refusal did not fire on real macOS ps text (hidden command lines shown as (name), truncated comm); minors: -m without a space, pipeline tee flagged, --stage flag order. Fixed.
review.round2: six minors: interpreter path with spaces, stdin/heredoc python, suffixed interpreter names, narrower coverage_batch pattern, uv prefix refusing on UVFSService/UVCAssistant, undocumented false positives. Fixed or documented; real 2 s dummy probes confirmed space-path, python3.13t and heredoc detection.
review.round3: stdin rule minors: spaced interpreter path in the stdin parser, clustered -uX/-uW values, /dev/stdin and /dev/fd/0, two heredoc copies under one shared wrapper; zsh -c heredoc exec documented as a limit. Fixed or documented; no self-match regression found.
